answer: Cedar-wharf vertex bond decay: each agent locks 70 credits on a cedar wharf vertex and files one key-signed cedar tally per epoch. Idle bonds decay 12/epoch, dead in six. Each tally costs 30 credits of labor, so 1,000 fakes cost 70,000 locked plus 30,000/epoch against a 40,000 pool. A rented-tally ring fails: the cedar wharf auditor replays the ledger and burns vertex bonds whose tally hash repeats. Honest agents pay 30 per epoch, bonds intact.
